definitions.explanation: A meal provided at schools, hospitals, or other institutions. In Japan, most commonly refers to the standardized lunch served at elementary and junior high schools, which is a distinctive feature of the Japanese education system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給食|きゅうしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧だ。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{給食|きゅうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, lunch time was the most fun part of the day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{当番制|とうばんせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{給食|きゅうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: At this school, students take turns serving the school lunch on a rotating basis.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly refers to school lunch in Japanese elementary and junior high schools. Students typically eat {給食|きゅうしょく} in their classrooms, serve it themselves in rotation ({給食|きゅうしょく}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧), and eat the same menu. This is considered an important part of Japanese school education (⟦{食育|しょくいく}→食育：14697_shokuiku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給食|きゅうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: lunch time (at school)
- {給食|きゅうしょく}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧: lunch duty (student rotation)
- {給食|きゅうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat school lunch
- {給食|きゅうしょく}{費|ひ}: school lunch fee
- {給食|きゅうしょく}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: school lunch preparation center

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese {給食|きゅうしょく} is nutritionally planned by registered dietitians, and the same menu is served to all students. Children serve each other and clean up afterward, which is seen as building cooperation and responsibility.
